limitations: Applies only to constant-step exact-arithmetic classical Heun integration of the scalar logistic equation on the complete carrying-capacity interval. scientific_integrity: The standard Heun map and numerical threshold near 4.4037 belong to the cited 2026 source. Finite tests do not establish universal conclusions.
title: Sharp logistic Heun invariance frontier and square-root failure window
